text_block_list.text:
During training—
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi stopped in her tracks and began mumbling something!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Which lap... was this again...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Round and round... round and round...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... The whole world is... spinning around...

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi seems dizzy with exhaustion
from running back-to-back races.
We should probably reconsider her future race schedule.
